simple.meaning: חֻשָׁתִי (Chushâthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֻשָׁתִי (H2843) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 21:18, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֻשָׁתִי (H2843) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֻשָׁתִי (H2843) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֻשָׁתִי (Chushâthîy) / H2843 is traced through 2 Samuel 21:18, 2 Samuel 23:27, 1 Chronicles 11:29, 1 Chronicles 20:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a Chushathite or descendant of Chushah
definitions.full: H2843. Chushathi חֻשָׁתִי adjective, of a people of foregoing: — 1 of individual, with article ׳הַח 2Sam 21:18 = 1Chr 20:4 ; 2Sam 23:27 = 1Chr 11:29 , see also 27:11 .

occurrences.englishText: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.
The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
